title: Lee Allen: first sight in Denver and his background
summary: He first saw Lee Allen at a USO in Denver, and says Allen came to New Orleans on a basketball scholarship and played with Paul Gayten.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: Yeah. Because I thought he played and everybody else, I imagine, thought he played better gut bucket, as they called it. And he did. See, actually, the first time I saw Lee Allen, I was in the service before I started playing. Mm-hmm. I was in Denver, Colorado at Fitzsummer General Hospital training to be a surgical tech.
And I'd go to the USO for the black USO and he was playing there. That's where I first saw Lee Allen in Denver, Colorado.
No, why? Because you saw him before you really probably met him. Yeah. Before he came to New Orleans. Right.
Yeah, Lee Allen actually came to New Orleans on a basketball scholarship to Xavier.
And I think he was doing music on the side, so to speak.
Yeah. And he was with Paul Gaten. So when we were thrown together, we kind of clicked. Mm-hmm. You know, it happened.
